div.div: مِسْأَدٌ A skin for clarified butter, (S, K, [see بَدْرَةٌ,]) or for honey; as also مِسَادٌ, without ء; the former of the measure مِفْعَلٌ, and the latter of the measure فِعَالٌ: or a [skin of the kind called] زِقّ, smaller than the حَمِيت [which is similarly described as a skin, or small skin, of the kind called زِقّ]: (El-Ahmar, L:) but Sh says, what we have heard is مِسْأَبٌ, meaning a large [skin of the kind called] زِقّ. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
